description:
send finds its receiver without hashing.

Today (machine.md M12; runtime/src/aot_shim.rs, aot_send_hook), every send runs `tasks.get_mut(&receiver_pid)` on the scheduler's HashMap<u32, Task> with the default SipHash: about 94 instructions per send (71 hash plus 23 probe). send(self(), b) followed by receive costs 1500 instructions in total. The rest is ParkRecord (~260), reach_receive (80), a 64 B closure per receive and 2 continuations per round trip; those belong to other tickets.

Fix: index tasks by pid directly. Pids are dense u32 from the scheduler, so a slab or Vec indexed by pid, with a generation check if pids are reused, is enough. Otherwise use a non-cryptographic hasher. Choose from how pids are allocated (read the scheduler first).

Asm first: target listing for the lookup (load, bounds check, state check).

Acceptance: the send probe (p10) falls by the lookup's cost (bench). Process fixtures pass, including exit and unknown pid.
title: send finds its receiver without hashing
